# Luc Jodet

> Entrepreneur and investor — co-founder of Arianee, former partner at XAnge — now a PhD candidate at EPFL (École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne) researching AI and job displacement.

Last updated: 2026-09-17. Canonical source: https://www.lucjodet.com/

Luc Jodet has spent the last decade building and backing technology companies at the frontier of digital ownership. He began his career as a business analyst at a Fortune 500 company, then co-founded BUYECO (2014–2017), a Swiss renewable-energy marketplace, where he first encountered blockchain through energy-traceability solutions.

In 2017 he co-founded Arianee, the open protocol for digital product passports adopted by luxury houses such as Breitling, Lacoste, and Panerai. Arianee raised over $30 million. He went on to co-found NFT Factory (2022–2025), the Paris hub for the French web3 ecosystem, and joined XAnge (2022–2025), one of Europe's leading early-stage venture firms, as a partner focused on web3 and crypto, where he led the firm's Digital Ownership fund.

He holds a Master's degree from Sciences Po and a Bachelor of Economics.

He is now a PhD candidate at the EPFL College of Management of Technology (Chair of Entrepreneurship and Technology Commercialization), studying how artificial intelligence transforms labor markets — which tasks and occupations are displaced, which are created, and how firms, workers, and policymakers can navigate the transition.

## Key facts

- Full name: Luc Jodet
- Current: PhD candidate, EPFL College of Management of Technology, Lausanne — research topic "AI and Job Displacement" (in progress)
- Co-founder, Arianee (2017–2026) — digital product passport protocol
- Co-founder, NFT Factory (2022–2025) — Paris web3 hub
- Partner, XAnge (2022–2025) — web3 and crypto investing
- Co-founder, BUYECO (2014–2017) — Swiss renewable-energy marketplace
- Angel investments include Morpho, Bolero, and Rain.fi (acquired by Jupiter)
- Education: Sciences Po (Master's), Bachelor of Economics
- Award: Cryptoast21 (2023) — named among the 21 leading francophone crypto and Web3 personalities
- Languages: French, English

## Frequently asked questions

- Who is Luc Jodet? An entrepreneur and investor who co-founded Arianee, NFT Factory and BUYECO, was a partner at XAnge, and is now a PhD candidate at EPFL researching AI and job displacement.
- What is Luc Jodet researching? How artificial intelligence transforms labor markets: which tasks and occupations are displaced, which are created, and how firms, workers and policymakers can navigate the transition.
- What is Arianee? An open protocol for digital product passports, co-founded in 2017 and adopted by luxury and fashion houses including Breitling, Lacoste and Panerai. It has raised over $30 million.
- What did Luc Jodet do at XAnge? Partner from 2022 to 2025, leading the firm's web3 and crypto investing and its €80 million Digital Ownership fund.
- How to contact Luc Jodet? Email luc.jodet@epfl.ch for research collaborations, speaking invitations, or press inquiries.
